new_findings: Q7 Color Space is live-write on focus, retain on confirm, backup-restore on cancel; initial activation and reopen also write the same byte. The HQ pending-only proposal is not original Q7 behavior.
The UI replay runs native E3 entry, mode setup, widgets, key/focus, settings and selected terminal handlers; eight external boundaries are modeled.
Card hash flag 0 selects two reads with actual-count/content comparison and at most two attempts; flag 1 uses a modeled hash worker. Equal short reads succeed only at this callback boundary.
Native BurnNand prologue reaches native section-map return using original payload bytes and a synthetic installed header/geometry; no storage writes executed.
Section3 protection uses header-mode and handle-protect bytes; section6 and generic sections use different payload/span conditions.
Lens capability combines communication-state bit 0x08 with group2/operation4, while transport admission has a separate map gate.
Cached big-endian lens values feed AF policy. Queue acknowledgement, timeout and live-view motion completion are distinct.
Replay tools now load exactly the verified bytes. Repacker failure rollback preserves pre-existing and colliding foreign files.
